title: dev-fake parameters
description: Knobs that make the fake adapter behave like a real one, or misbehave on purpose for supervisor and conformance tests.

warn.description: Emit this warning code once during execute.

failWith.description: Fail execute with this catalog error code after the first page.

crash.description: Raise an unexpected exception after the first page.

hang.description: Ignore cancel and never finish, so the supervisor's watchdog must kill the worker.

noise.description: print() to stdout during execute, to prove stray output can't corrupt the protocol.
